Generated surrogate key: 141 + row_number() OVER (ORDER BY CASE WHEN bet_type_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, bet_type_id, prod_clss_id)
  Starting point: Base offset 141 ensures no collision with legacy keys
  Ranking logic:
    Primary sort: NULL bet_type_id records first (CASE returns 1 for NULL, 0 for non-NULL)
    Secondary sort: bet_type_id ASC (Fixed Odds bet types)
    Tertiary sort: prod_clss_id ASC (Product class/Non-FO bet types)
  Result: Sequential integer starting from 142 (141 + 1)
  Ensures: Non-FO bet types (with NULL bet_type_id) are ranked first
  Purpose: Dimension key for referential integrity and join operations

Composite business key: concat_ws('||', 'default', coalesce(bet_type_id, '-1'), coalesce(prod_clss_id, '-1'))
  Components: 'default' || bet_type_id || prod_clss_id
  Example: 'default||3||' (FO exacta) or 'default||-1||5' (Non-FO bet type)
  Coalesce handling: Replaces NULL with '-1' string representation
  Format: Pipe-delimited composite key maintaining both FO and non-FO identifiers
  Purpose: Business key for reconciliation and alternative lookup

Current status of the outcome - derived via CASE logic from status dimension:
  'OPN' = is_active=T AND is_displayed=T AND is_resulted=F AND is_settled=F (Open for betting)
  'SUS' = is_active=F AND is_displayed=T AND is_resulted=F AND is_settled=F (Suspended)
  NULL = all other conditions (CLS=Closed, OFF=Off market not yet implemented)
  Source: ob_sport_outcome_status_hist (most recent status via qualify rn=1)

Result code mapping - derived via CASE logic from result dimension:
  'LSE' = result='L' (Lose)
  'RNI' = result IN ('U', '-') (Result Not In)
  'WIN' = result='W' (Win)
  'RFE' = result='V' (Refunded)
  'PLx' = CONCAT('PL', CAST(place AS STRING)) when result='P' (Place result with place number)
  'HANDICAP' = result='H' (Handicap - logic incomplete per comment)
  Source: ob_sport_outcome_result_hist (most recent result via qualify rn=1)

Dead heat reduction factor for PLACE outcomes - derived from dead_heat reduction:
